368191.title: A line with labor by a deleted staff member still reads Deleted user
368191.custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. A work order at this location has a line whose labor was logged by a staff member who has since been deleted, so its Labor row reads "Deleted user". To find one: open the work orders you know were worked by former staff and check their Lines tab. If there is none on this site, mark the case Blocked with 'no Deleted user line on this site'.
  5. To give a technician a shift: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto the technician's row at the start time > in the picker choose Entire work order (or Choose lines and tick a line) > set the end time > save.
  6. On the Schedule give an eligible technician (e.g. "Jenny Wilson") a shift tomorrow on that work order with Choose lines and that line ticked.
368191.custom_steps:
1. Open the work order and click the Lines tab.
  2. Read that line's Labor row.
368191.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Labor row still reads "Deleted user". The scheduled technician does not replace a line that has real labor.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §8; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (S7-R8). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §8: “A line with real labor keeps its labor technician, and "Deleted user" stays.”
  • PRD S7-R8: “On the work order’s Lines tab, a line with no labor technician but with technicians scheduled on it from the Schedule shows those technicians’ names in its Labor row, in place of “Unassigned”.”

368244.title: A new photo shows in Board View after a reload
368244.custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as an Admin (the Admin role can see every page used below).
  2. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  3. Two clearly different photos on your computer (e.g. a red square and a blue square). Upload the red one as the person's photo first (on the staff member's record, or your own profile).
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Esther Howard leads at least one work order here. Use a desktop window at least 1024 px wide.
368244.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, pick Board View in the display switcher (in the design its tooltip reads "Board") and look at the avatar in Esther Howard's column header.
  2. Upload the blue photo as Esther Howard's photo.
  3. Go back to the same place and reload the page.
  4. Look at the avatar again.
368244.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the upload the avatar shows the red photo.
  • After the reload it shows the blue photo, not the old red one.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 9; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §9, hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 9: “Avatars everywhere (header, Staff, Schedule, cards). Avatars are now cached. After someone uploads a new photo, a reload must show the new one.”
  • QA handoff §9: “After a new photo is uploaded, a reload shows the new image.”
